hero.title: Run your whole school from one place
hero.body: Sanchalix brings admissions, attendance, fees, exams and parent communication together, so the office, teachers and families all work from the same up-to-date records.

features.title: Everything the school day needs
features.description: One system instead of registers, spreadsheets and separate apps.

students.title: Students and admissions
students.body: Follow each applicant from enquiry to admission, keep student and guardian records in one place, import in bulk, and promote classes at year end.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Take daily or period-wise attendance in seconds, with holidays and working days built in, and see the month at a glance in the register.

fees.title: Fees and receipts
fees.body: Set fee structures with installments, collect at the counter with numbered receipts that can't be altered, and know who owes what.

exams.title: Exams and report cards
exams.body: Schedule papers, let subject teachers enter marks, lock and publish results, and print report cards with remarks.

timetable.title: Timetable and homework
timetable.body: Build a weekly timetable that never double-books a teacher, and let teachers set homework for the sections they teach.

communication.title: Announcements and calendar
communication.body: Reach the whole school or chosen roles with announcements, and keep events and holidays on one shared calendar.

roles.title: Built for everyone at school
roles.description: Each person signs in to exactly what they need, and nothing they shouldn't see.

office.title: Office and principal
office.body: Records, approvals, staff, leave and a dashboard of the day.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.body: Today's classes, attendance, homework and marks for their own sections.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: The fee counter, receipts, payments and the dues report.

families.title: Students and parents
families.body: Attendance, homework, fees due, results and report cards for their own child.

setup.title: Set up your school
setup.body: Add classes, sections, subjects and staff, then import your students from a spreadsheet.

run.title: Run the day
run.body: Take attendance, collect fees, set homework and enter marks as the day goes on.

share.title: Keep families informed
share.body: Parents and students sign in to see attendance, dues, results and announcements.

cta.title: Ready to open your school?
cta.body: Sign in with the account your school gave you.

footer.tagline: One system for admissions, attendance, fees, exams and parent communication.
footer.credit: Designed and developed by Digiconn Unite
